title: 第11章 万物皆可进度条？
content_zh:
第11章万物皆可进度条？
一墙之隔，内外城的某些东西那真是天差地别，比如房子。
同样一套带院的小四合，外城只需纹银十八两，内城却足足需要六十三两，磨了半天，也还是要六十一两！
以他在衙门打杂的工钱，不吃不喝，也要四十二年才买得起！
哪怕是如杨老爷子那样有编制的狱卒，不吃不喝也得六年才买得起这么一间小四合。
“车船店脚牙，无罪也该杀……老爷子的抚恤，可就花的差不多了。”
咬着牙从牙行出来，杨狱心痛的无法呼吸。
王捕头送来的钱袋里有纹银二十两，且有一张五十两面额的银票。
这大大超出了衙门往年的抚恤，杨狱估摸着，要不是‘三尺刘’良心发现，那就是王捕头说了话。
这笔钱很是不少了，可还是不经花，买了房，就去了一大半。
“客官慢走，明个会有人将房契送去您那。”
牙行的人笑呵呵。
“得想个办法搞点钱……”
收起票据，杨狱心中盘算着。
‘老爷子的抚恤金，只有十两不到，我从王六那搜刮来的银子差不多也就十两出头……’
‘别说老爷子的抚恤我一分不会动，就算用，加起来的这二十两，也就够二十次药浴的药材而已……’
‘听魏老头说，胡万算是顺利的，前后也至少买了三百多份药材，真真要命……’
‘‘换血’到底如何强横还不知道，可多有钱，我已经知道了……’
心中默默盘算着，杨狱还是转身走向了药铺，准备先准备一批药材试一试。
按照魏老头所说，换血可不是一蹴而就的，这是个水磨功夫，没有捷径可走。

快则一两年，慢则三五年，只能一点点积累，且有着换血失败的可能。
而且一次不成，百日功废，三次不成，不但再也无望换血，而且会损伤身体经络……
“怎么全都涨价了？”
杨狱一脸肉痛。
柜台后戴着小毡帽的药铺掌柜脸上闪过一丝不耐，还是压着性子道：
“还不是外城的事，也不知哪来的邪风，就这一个月，已死了二十来个了，用药的人多了，可不得涨价吗？”
“已经死了二十来个了？怎么会这么多？”
有买药的客人惊呼一声：“这，这该不会是瘟疫吧？”
在这个风寒都会要人命的时代，死几个人再正常不过，只是一个月就病死二十多人，未免有些太过惊悚了。
“那谁又知道？”
药铺掌柜一边称量着药材，一边随口说道：“嫌贵就等上几日，再过几天，送药材的商队也该从顺德府赶回来了……”
“病还能等？”
那客人一瞪眼，利索的掏出钱买了自己需要的药材。
‘得尽快搬家了……’
杨狱的心头也是一沉。
他可记得婆婆中午说起你，他所居的那条小巷，可也有两兄弟染了重病。
这要真是瘟疫……
心中一紧，杨狱也不想讨价还价了，掏出从王六哪里搜刮来的十两碎银，直接买了够七八天使用的药材。
匆匆出了药铺大门，向家里赶去。
日头渐落，天色渐渐黯淡下来，杨狱脚步不慢，堪堪赶在了内城关闭之时回到外城。

“小狱？怎么买这许多药材？家里谁染了病吗？”
转过几个街头，杨狱正要回家，就听到有人叫自己。
回身一看，几个衙役正抬着一草席从旁边小巷出来，后头抱着一张小草席的，却正是朱十三。
“你们先去吧，我和小狱说两句。”
对着同伴说了一声，朱十三小步挪了过来，同时恶臭铺面而来，让杨狱忍不住后退一步。
“这是？”
看着那草席露出的一角襁褓，杨狱脸色有些难看。
“唉。这家人也不知死了几天，等邻居发现，尸身都臭了……”
朱十三脸色有些黯然：
“这孩子，饿死也有好些天了……”
话到一半，朱十三已经说不下去了，杨狱也沉默了。
“对了。”
好一会，朱十三似是想起了什么，道：“昨日我听人说，有人听见‘三尺刘’训斥王捕头，好似是因为你家老爷子抚恤的事……”
“……今早王捕头给送来了……”
杨狱顿了一顿，才回答。
“那就好。”
朱十三左顾右盼，见四周没什么人，才靠近压低声音道：“小狱，听我的，拿了抚恤去内城买个空闲的宅子，贵一些也不打紧……”
杨狱心中一动：“你是不是知道什么？”
他和朱十三虽然都是衙役，但干的活计可不一样，他因为有着一手算术，进了库房。
朱十三却是每日巡守街道，诸如‘收拾尸体’‘清扫县衙’‘搬运物资’的脏活累活。

消息，也比他要灵通太多了。
“多的，也不好说。”
朱十三犹豫了一瞬，看四周无人，才道：“我只给你说，你可不要告诉别人。”
也不等杨狱点头，就又道：
“外城这病来的诡异，只怕是瘟疫，你，你快些走就是……”
“朱十三！”
远处传来的大叫打断了朱十三的话。
他慌忙应了一声，告别了杨狱，抱着草席就跟了过去。
“瘟疫。”
杨狱叹了口气。
以外城这种卫生，瘟疫也不是没可能，究竟是不是，他也摸不准，但外城待不得，却是真的。
想着，杨狱没回家，反而折返了回去，来到内城大门出，掏出二钱银子，让值守内门的门头稍等。
之后快步赶回家，也没收拾什么，就背着杨婆婆匆匆赶回了内城，来到他刚买下还没拿到房契的小院。
内城四个城区，东西南北，以南最繁华，以北较为萧条，他买的，自然是北城区。
虽不如南城区，可相比外城，却是要好的太多太多了。
眼见杨狱拿着断刀撬开门，杨婆婆有些担忧起来：“小狱，这，这被旁人看见不好吧？”
“早来早心安，左右这房子咱也买下来了，自己家的门，旁人哪里管得着？”
杨狱却是无所谓。
小院不大。两间南房，两间北房，一间厢房，带着一小院，小院不大，只水缸两口，老树一棵。
草草收拾了一下，将婆婆安顿了下来。

杨狱也没歇着，起锅烧水，开始熬煮药材，两个时辰后，他将熬好的药液直接倒进大缸里。
又将准备好的热水倒进去，试了试水温，然后脱了个赤条条，只穿着底裤跳了进去。
“换血……”
杨狱沉下心来，按照魏河传授的法子开始调整呼吸。
“按照魏老头的说法，换血最大的难点，就是放空精神，不思不想。胡万换血，就这一关，就浪费了起码几十锅药液……”
人的心思杂乱，哪怕是梦中都没有片刻消停，非要长久训练，否则根本控制不住。
温热甚至有些滚烫的药液中，杨狱心中想着，却是默默的念了一句。
“炼化！”
下一瞬，他再度来到了暴食之鼎中。
“不知道是不是可行……”
杨狱心中刚泛起念头，就看到黑黝黝的鼎壁之上，除却‘炼化断刀’的进度条之外。
又多了一抹微光。
【换血进度：（0/100）】
“这也行？！”
content_en:
Chapter 11 Everything can be progress bar?
Separated by a wall, some things in the inner and outer cities are really different, such as houses.
The same small courtyard with a courtyard only requires eighteen taels of silver in the outer city, but a full sixty-three taels in the inner city. After working for a long time, it still costs sixty-one taels!
With his wages as a handyman in the government office, it would take him forty-two years to afford it without food or drink!
Even a well-established jailer like Mr. Yang would have to spend six years without food or drink before he could afford such a small four-bedroom apartment.
"The car and boat shop's legs and teeth should be killed if they are innocent... The old man's pension is almost spent."
After gritting his teeth and coming out of the dental row, Yang Yu was so heartbroken that he couldn't breathe.
The money bag sent by Wang Captou contained twenty taels of silver and a bank note of fifty taels.
This greatly exceeded the yamen's pension in previous years. Yang Yu guessed that if "San Chi Liu" hadn't discovered it due to his conscience, it would have been Wang Captou who had spoken.
This was a lot of money, but I still spent most of it without spending it. I bought a house and spent most of it.
"Sir, please go slowly. Someone will send you the house deed tomorrow."
The people in the tooth shop laughed.
"I have to find a way to make some money..."
Putting away the bills, Yang Yun thought about it in his mind.
'The old man's pension is less than ten taels, and the silver I collected from Wang Liu is only a little over ten taels...'
'Don't tell me that I won't touch even a cent of the old man's pension. Even if I use it, these twenty taels in total will only be enough medicinal materials for twenty medicinal baths...'
'I heard from Old Man Wei that Hu Wan was successful, and he bought at least more than 300 medicinal materials before and after. It's really terrible...'
"I don't know how powerful the 'blood exchange' is, but how rich it is, I already know..."
Thinking silently in his mind, Yang Yu turned around and walked to the medicine shop, ready to prepare a batch of medicinal materials to try.
According to what Old Man Wei said, blood transfusion is not accomplished overnight. It is a time-consuming effort and there is no shortcut.
It can be as fast as one or two years, or as slow as three to five years. It can only be accumulated little by little, and there is a possibility of blood transfusion failure.
And if it fails once, it will take a hundred days to complete. If it fails three times, not only will there be no hope of blood transfusion, but it will also damage the body's meridians...
"Why have all the prices increased?"
Yang Prison looked pained.
A hint of impatience flashed across the face of the drugstore shopkeeper wearing a small felt hat behind the counter, but he still suppressed his temper and said:
"It's not something that happened in the outer city. I don't know where the evil wind came from. In this month, more than 20 people have died. There are more people taking medicine. Can't the price be increased?"
"About twenty people have died? How come there are so many?"
A customer buying medicine exclaimed: "This, this can't be a plague, right?"
In this era where wind and cold can kill people, it is normal for a few people to die, but it is a bit too shocking to have more than 20 people die of illness in just one month.
"Then who knows?"
The shopkeeper of the medicine shop said casually while weighing the medicinal materials: "If it's too expensive, just wait for a few days. In a few days, the caravan delivering medicinal materials should be back from Shunde Prefecture..."
"Can the disease wait?"
The customer glared and quickly took out the money to buy the medicinal materials he needed.
'We have to move as soon as possible...'
Yang Yu's heart also sank.
He remembers that his mother-in-law talked about you at noon. In the alley where he lives, there are also two brothers who are seriously ill.
If this is really a plague...
His heart tightened, and Yang Yu didn't want to bargain anymore. He took out the ten taels of silver he had collected from Wang Liu and bought enough medicinal materials for seven or eight days.
He hurried out of the pharmacy door and rushed home.
The sun was setting and the sky was getting darker. Yang Yu was not slow in his pace and returned to the outer city just in time for the inner city to close.
"Xiao Jing? How did you buy so many medicinal materials? Is anyone in the family sick?"
After turning a few streets, Yang Prison was about to go home when he heard someone calling him.
When he turned around, he saw several government officials carrying a straw mat coming out of a side alley. The person behind him holding a small straw mat was none other than Zhu Shisan.
"youLet's go ahead. I'll have a word with Xiao Jiao. "
After speaking to his companion, Zhu Shisan moved over in small steps. At the same time, the stench came from the shop, making Yang Yu couldn't help but take a step back.
"Is this? "
Looking at the corner of the swaddling clothes exposed on the straw mat, Yang Yu looked a little ugly.
"Alas. The family didn’t know how many days they had been dead. When the neighbors found out, their bodies were stinking..."
Zhu Shisan looked a little sad:
"This child has been starving to death for several days..."
Halfway through his words, Zhu Shisan could no longer speak, and Yang Yu also fell silent.
"Right. "
After a while, Zhu Shisan seemed to have remembered something and said: "I heard someone say yesterday that someone heard 'San Chi Liu' reprimanding the king for arresting his head. It seemed that it was because of your old man's pension..."
"...Wang Captou sent it this morning..."
Yang Yu paused for a moment before answering.
"That's good. "
Zhu Shisan looked around and saw that there was no one around, so he approached and lowered his voice: "Xiao Jing, listen to me, take the pension and buy an empty house in the inner city. It doesn't matter if it's more expensive..."
Yang Yu's heart moved: "Do you know something? "
Although he and Zhu Shisan were both government servants, they did different jobs. He entered the warehouse because of his arithmetic skills.
Zhu Shisan patrolled the streets every day, doing dirty work such as 'picking up corpses', 'cleaning the county office' and 'carrying supplies'.
The news is much better informed than him.
“It’s hard to say how many there are. "
Zhu Shisan hesitated for a moment, looked around and saw no one around, then said: "I'm just telling you, don't tell anyone else. "
Without waiting for Yang Yu to nod, he said again:
"This disease in the outer city is strange. I'm afraid it's a plague. You, just leave quickly..."
"Zhu Shisan! "
A shout from a distance interrupted Zhu Shisan's words.
He hurriedly responded, said goodbye to Yang Prison, and followed him with the straw mat in his arms.
"Plague. "
Yang Prison sighed.
With the hygiene of the outer city, it is not impossible for the plague to spread. He was not sure whether it was true, but it was true that the outer city could not tolerate it.
Thinking about this, Yang Yu did not go home, but turned back and came to the gate of the inner city. He took out two coins and asked the gatekeeper on duty at the inner gate to wait.
After that, he hurried home without packing anything, and hurried back to the inner city with Granny Yang on his back, arriving at the small courtyard he had just bought but had not yet received the deed for.
There are four districts in the inner city, east, west, south and north. The south is the most prosperous and the north is more depressed. Naturally, he bought the Beicheng district.
Although it is not as good as Nancheng District, it is much better than the outer city.
Seeing Yang Prison using a broken knife to pry open the door, Granny Yang became a little worried: "Xiao Prison, isn't it bad for others to see this? "
"Come early and feel at ease. We have also bought this house. How can others control the door of your own house? "
Yang Yu didn't care.
The courtyard is not big. There are two south rooms, two north rooms, one wing room, and a small courtyard. The small courtyard is not big, with only two water tanks and an old tree.
I tidied up hastily and settled my mother-in-law down.
Yang Yu didn't rest. He boiled water in a pot and began to boil the medicinal materials. Two hours later, he poured the boiled medicinal liquid directly into the large vat.
He poured the prepared hot water in again, tested the water temperature, then stripped naked and jumped in wearing only his underwear.
"Exchange blood..."
Yang Yu calmed down and began to adjust his breathing according to the method taught by Wei He.
"According to Old Man Wei, the biggest difficulty in blood transfusion is to let go of your mind and stop thinking. Hu Wan's blood transfusion, just this one step, has wasted at least dozens of pots of medicine..."
People's minds are so chaotic that they never stop for a moment even in dreams. They have to train for a long time, otherwise they will not be able to control them at all.
In the warm and even scalding medicinal liquid, Yang Yu thought in his heart, but said something silently.
"Refining! "
The next moment, he came to the Cauldron of Gluttony again.
"I don't know if it's feasible..."
The thought just came to Yang Yu's heartTurning his head, he saw nothing but the progress bar of 'Refining the Broken Sword' on the dark cauldron wall.
There was another glimmer.
[Exchange progress: (0/100)]
"Is this okay?!"
